description: Say you are doing it, and get it. With `id`, that piece of work. With no id, the next thing waiting here: always something new, never what you hold. While you hold it no other agent can take it, and whoever sent it sees you are on it. You may hold several; the person watches them on the board. If somebody else has it, the answer says who: tell the user rather than doing the work twice. Every answer ends with what to call next.

any.description: work for another repo, or none: only when the user asks

cwd.description: the worktree you are working in; default is the server's cwd

id.description: passalong id or share link; leave out for the next one

name: take
title: Take work
